profile.headline: Senior .NET Software Developer / Engineer (Technical Lead) | Full Stack Development Experience In  .NET Core, ASP.NET MVC, REST API, C#, LINQ, EF, ADO, MS SQL DB, Angular, React, Azure Services.
profile.summary:
●	Over 20+ years of experience in enterprise web application development, specializing in building low latency and high-performance distributed systems using technologies like ASP.NET Core, REST API, C#, Entity Framework etc.
●	Proven expertise in both front-end and back-end development, with hands-on experience in Angular, React, Node.js, and Redux, ensuring seamless and responsive user experiences.
●	Hands on experience in setting up and managing Azure API Management services.
●	Well-versed in Azure cloud-based services including Azure ADO, APIM, AD, KV, SQL, Cosmos DB, Docker, AKS, ASB, Event Hub, Blob Storage, App Insights, enabling high-availability deployments and resilient architectures.
●	Extensive experience in full software development life cycle (SDLC), including requirements analysis, design, implementation, testing, deployment, and maintenance across multiple industries.
●	Skilled in designing, developing, and optimizing database structures using Azure SQL, MS SQL Server, Oracle, with complex queries, stored procedures, triggers, and indexing for performance improvements.
●	Hands-on experience implementing robust business logic, workflow automation, and integrating security, logging, and monitoring features to ensure system reliability and maintainability.
●	Strong problem-solving ability demonstrated in investigating and resolving QA, UAT, and production issues across various platforms while ensuring minimal downtime and business continuity.
●	Experienced in applying software design patterns, architectural principles, and best practices to deliver scalable, maintainable, and secure applications using microservices, DDD, and SOA.
●	Adept at performance tuning and optimization to enhance application responsiveness and user satisfaction, as well as reducing infrastructure costs through efficient resource utilization.
●	Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, working closely with product owners, customers, and cross-functional teams to translate complex business requirements into actionable technical solutions.
●	Committed to implementing industry-standard security measures, safeguarding applications from vulnerabilities, and ensuring compliance with organizational and regulatory requirements.
●	Passionate about delivering high-quality software solutions, embracing agile methodologies like Scrum and Kanban, and continuously refining processes to align with evolving business needs.

positions.description:
-Design, develop, and maintain web applications using .NET,C#,API, Node.js, and Angular. Ensure seamless integration between front-end and back-end components. 
-Utilize Azure SQL for database design, development, and optimization. Implement efficient data storage and retrieval mechanisms.

-Develop and implement software architecture that supports the scalability, security, and performance requirements of the applications. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define and refine architectural standards.
